in_marathi.name: Manvi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manvi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'manas' meaning 'mind' and 'vijnana' meaning 'intelligence' or 'knowledge'. It represents the power of intellect and the ability to understand and process complex ideas. In Hindu mythology, Manvi is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge and wisdom.
